author: kycrafft
body:
On some maps there is spawn protection and others don't have any. Some mods apparently allow spawnkilling in Nexus and some don't. 

My suggestions:

Remove the "do not enter (team color)'s spawn". What happens is I chase a guy who is at one heart and he runs into his teams spawn. Wow. And then I get stuck in the barrier when someone hits me from behind and I can't move. Super great, eh?

So take away the current spawn protection and give the spawn protection timer for 3-4 seconds. This way you can chase someone into their spawn, kill them, and get the heck out of there. Also it would fix spawnkilling.
